pages.title: Artist's Palette
pages.text:
The Artist's Palette combines the Ink-storing ability of the Pigment Palette with your new capabilities to mix colors.\
\
It directly stores elemental Ink and mixes the others on the fly, while having vastly increased capacity.

pages.title: Fusion Recipe
pages.text:
Capable of storing sizable amounts of Ink, making you able to supply all your magical equipment.\
\
It is not suited for powering your machines, though.
